mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 4.0% signals imminent monetary easing, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0.
